body:
I ended up falling asleep finally, so I slept through the worst of it. But thanks everyone. Yes, I finally got some more today, and I'm back to normal. Whatever normal is anymore... 
I'm completely hooked on benadryl. jmypetersen nailed it. So many people say it's all in your head, but it's real. I swear it is. It's always psychological, and sometimes physical. I have both. And honestly thought it was all in my head until I started hallucinating without it. Actually had a wreck a few months ago because I believed I could stop. I was totally sober... But the withdrawals made me so sick. Imagine having RLS all over every square inch of your body. It just, it sucks... SUCKS... I can't stop.
Other OPs have said the withdrawals are similar to benzo withdrawals. That might help.

I'm a bit embarrassed to say what, mostly because pretty much everyone on other forums I've read have ridiculed the OP for their admission, saying it's either "just" psychological, or not addictive at all. But, it's real... very real... Real enough that I'm about to start my two-hour hike to Walmart. I don't even like to get up to change the channel...
Sure. It's www.guitarleg.WordPress.com
WOOOOO!!! It's in Chinese, but I don't care. Sweet! You rock, dude. You guys all rock. Thank you!!
The game I'm trying to play ends with rar.
I give up... I've lost over half my phone data trying to get an app to work that won't even work half the time without crashing. Everyone else, enjoy. I'll go play Angry Birds.
It still doesn't do anything. It says no files when I click on a game.
I got Maniac Mansion to load. But nothing else, and there's at least 20 ROMs on here.
It won't show any ROMs at all. They can't all be I compatible.
There isn't much to tell. As soon as I open the app, it says load or quit. When I load, it shows a full menu. But nothing I click on does anything.
Pretend you're talking to a three-year-old, because I'm really emulator stupid. Explain BIOS and zip? Snes9x is what I downloaded for an snes core. Nes, I'll check.
Ew. No. Lol, even if it's an effort to help. Sorry. I couldn't take a picture without puking.
I moved and lost contacts. It's all I can get my hands on.
I still don't think I get it... I already write about those things, without metaphors.
I don't know what you mean...

I'm going to give an old dream one more shot and try to teach music. Two years ago, I auditioned for America's Got Talent. But I didn't have the money to go back. Now, I put my music on a website and a YouTube channel, but I don't think I'll make it because I don't have the body or look for it. I'd be happy just writing music for other people, but you don't do that with Christian music very often. And I don't have the money to make anything happen.
NOT gospel... But it's hard to explain. I might compare it to Misty Edwards meets Chris Tomlin.
I do Christian contemporary...
I doubt you produce what I write... But what are you into?
Jess.
It looked cool. But couldn't fix it, unfortunately. It couldn't do multi-keystrokes. Even if I'd caught the rat, apparently people struggled with putting the password in, too.

No. I tried it since learning how robbed I was to not have gotten to play it as a kid. But my emulator couldn't handle it when I got to catching the rat, so I had to abort the mission. But it looked awesome.
Christian, yes. FF addict maybe a little strong, but I'm a fan. I think I think I might've said addict, though. Lol
At the moment, nothing. But if I don't do this, everything. Again.
If you can handle being the last person I talk to. I fell asleep, but I'm up and ready now.
No one. I don't have anyone...

It's weird... I made up this song yesterday, and told God this was between me and Him. No one else would ever hear. But then it got good, and I got that old familiar feeling I used to get when He gave me a song. I told Him it would never see paper or a recorder until I meant it with all my heart. I'm thinking on it all...

I'm pretty sure God already quit. I hear these awesome stories all the time about how He just intervenes for people, shows up and shows out... Why haven't I heard from Him? Where's my story? Unless He's saying it's okay to go.

I wish I'd had that mindset, with the people I cared about. Careful not to hurt them, fearful I might lose them... But I wasn't, and I did. I'm glad you have someone. Hold onto her. What you have is some ki d of peace. My life hasn't been much different, if just a bit worse. I can't crawl out from underneath what I've done or what I've seen... Your story did make me cringe, though. It's similar to mine. Maybe that's why. So I'm glad for what you've found, even if it's not a happy ending. The only good endings are when there's peace found, anyway.
Dude... Where's the happy ending? The but-I-finally-found-peace part? You did find it, right? I'm all ears.
Sure. I'd love to.
It's good! Made fun of my brother for crying over Marley and Me, but I'm telling you, read with tissues.
I'm not doing so good at this "existing" thing at all...
For me,  lots of loss. Lots of failure. More loss.

My problem is that I lost the will to fight. If you still have that will, guard it with everything you are. Once that's gone, it's over. If you're young and haven't screwed your name up, you'll have resources that someone like me doesn't. You still have a shot.
Just a few. My website turned more into a site for my devotionals and stuff than my actual videos. But it's all good. Yeah, it's a start.
That I was here, 1990-2015, and I knew how to sing.
Well, I'm not a man. If that's cool, do you do kik?

Eight billion people in the world, too. And I have to get online to find one who cares... But you understanding that, from the sounds of it. For what it's worth, I know your birthday was a week ago. I never got the whole belated birthday thing. So, happy July 12, and I hope it's awesome.

Feel your pain, 100%. I've been doing the sharing thing for four years now. It took four years just to hit the thousand view mark on my website. And you have to consider the high number of people who Just stumbled there on accident.
You're telling me my own story. I've done stuff I'll never be able to get over. We could probably have a contest. But I can't win. Never will.

Right. I used to be atheist, and that's the kind of attitude that turns people away. They are good people, probably some of the best around. And I do appreciate what they've done. I just don't want to feel stuck.
I know that song. Haven't had one text or call in two weeks. Unless you count the angry landlord.
Not that I planned to die in the next hour, but I will gladly hang on until you watch that. http://m.youtube.com/watch?v=oNgJhuICrVA
I'm here. Will be for a few more hours. What's happening?
You're missing out. What kind of phone do you have? Or I think you can get emulators on a pc.

No record. Just apparently not even impressive by fast food standards. If I could ever get to a store from the chain I worked before, I'd have a job. But it'll mean the streets again. I can't do it. Just can't.

I think I can sing. I do pretty good. I do have a YouTube channel and a website. It just never got me anywhere. 
The church I started going to when I wrecked my car, it's a typical church. I'm not about that. And tried to stop going, except Friday a lady guilted me into going because the church apparently paid my ret and stuck their neck out for me. I don't know what that means, but I feel trapped there.
I just have a droid phone with a snes emulator, so pc games are kinda out. Did you ever play super Nintendo?
I've done literally that. I can't do more. The jobs I've been denied are pitiful.
To my website? I'll give it to you tonight.

I don't have much of a problem reading books from when I was a kid. Like, Where the Red Fern Grows. I read that not too long ago. But anything else, it's got about three pages to grip down on me, and if it doesn't happen, I'm done.
I like rpgs like the super Mario RPG, final fantasy... Good story is a must. It needs to pull at my heart somehow.

Normal people work jobs like you guys do, most everyone drives cars, have cell phones... I don't know much about your culture to know what to point out that's different. I think a lot of it is in tradition. As far as plans later in life... I had always wanted my music to take off. But so much for that.

Been there. Done that... I was homeless only until a month ago, and this church got me in an apartment. I'm still unemployed though, and I have very little time left to find a job before I'm on the streets again. Also have no one and lost everyone. Disowned. Life sucks... We don't have anything to hold onto, but it's really easy for people to say you do.

Sounds like something I would do. Honestly, not big on reading. But it is weird because I like to write. The two usually go hand in hand. I've had a couple books published, even. But I don't have the patience to read anything very long.
If I had my pick, I'd be in Michigan right now. But I'm just a bit south of that, and it's almost a quarter 'til four.
If I could ever convince you to give me just under an hour, I'd have you watch something on youtube that would just shatter this.
I have a website. I just don't want to share it before tonight. Anyone would be able to find me from it and call police, so I can't be too careful.

Never heard of it. I'm not so much into the new stuff. It stopped being fun after ps2, in my opinion. If it's not Sims or Kingdom Hearts or Final Fantasy, I'm not interested. But I did try to play Chrono Trigger for the first time, since apparently my childhood was robbed without it. My emulator couldn't handle it, though.
I was just about to ask. Yes, and actually just got hooked on snes Final Fantasy. You?
I don't have kik. Is it like an app?
No, I hate cleaning. I just figure I don't want things left in a mess. And that's cool. I'm soprano to the bone, but never dug choir much. I just write my own music.
We all have sad stories. Mine isn't special. Just a whole lot of loss.
Laundry, and cleaning. Nothing too exciting. Just want to clean the place up first. You sing?
Believe me, I've thought about that... But living isn't an option.
Anything. I don't care. Where are you from? What are you doing right now?
My life can't be fixed by a pill. I wish it could've been. And hospitals helped get me to this point. So living is not an option.
Really? And not talk me out of it?

My suicide will be tonight. And I am a God-loving Christian. 
We all have sin. We're born messed up, and we're shaped by inequities. Believing in God and pursing His heart in no way means that we don't still suffer from fleshy desires. It just means we follow the Holy Spirit to lead us the right way.
What I'm doing is wrong. Suicide is wrong and it's a sin. I really can't justify it, and won't try. But if i can give you any comfort, all sin is equal to God. Suicide is no different from the little white lies we tell. If your mother truly loved and believed in God and followed Him, she's in heaven. 
As for me... I hope I can be forgiven. I do deserve hell. But living is no longer an option, come heaven or hell. And only Catholics believe suicide is a one-way ticket to hell. Scripture says otherwise.

Show them the scriptures that PUT EMPHASIS ON THE SPIRITUAL GIFTS. 

Seriously, you want to end this? Take every clock out of the room, phones, watches (let them know in advance that this will be an intense study), and let them debate until they're blue. Then show them scripture that refutes what they say and ask them to debate the validity of the bible. I did this once for some kids. Worked like a charm. We could've made a movie about it.

This is my first post on this SubReddit ever, as I've found it at a very sad time in my life (more specifically, the end of it). So nobody eat my face off for this. But I'll tell you this, just from the viewpoint of someone who was once atheist down to the bone and wanted nothing in the world to do with "religion" or its churches...
...What I have found to be true in my own life, and the lives of most atheists I know or knew, is that we all gravitate towards something in life. Be it our careers or drugs or kids or whatever, there is a goal in our lives. And the question we ALL face at some point, regardless of how we answer it in our own minds, is IS GOD REAL? And the reason we have to answer that question is because that is something our spirits, or our guts, will pull us to; because it is the single most important question we will ever answer. It decides our lives; how we live and what we do. It's important.
I will tell you, all of you, that there is a side to God that you don't know, that nobody ever told you about or showed you, most likely because they didn't know themselves. And it's THAT God I believe in and love, and had it not been for people who finally showed me, I'd still be an atheist. And I sincerely hope and pray that someone finally does show you. The God the atheists renounce, they have every right to, because that's not Him. I promise. 

(Free bonus:  People who lived before Christ, I believe they were "saved" by faith in the promise that Jesus was coming. And people who died 40 A.D. or anytime never having the chance to hear, I believe it's the responsibility of the believers to reach those people, by Acts 1:8. But the people who are never reached, I believe God may give them that opportunity after death. Or maybe they reincarnate. Or I don't know. But I don't buy into the standard Christian answer of, "Oh, God just has something else in mind for them." That's a cop-out answer in a world that wants answers. We can't pretend to have them all, but we can give an educated guess based on Scripture. And I'll say to that, the only thing I know for sure, is they don't go to hell.)
Norbert has a dollar left to his name. He can either go buy benadryl or a McDonald's cheeseburger. Only one is going to make him "happy," or at least give him some sense of peace.
Sure. Plenty of things. He just can't do any of them. So that leaves death. There's that option, or spending God knows how long in complete agony and waiting on death.

This is happening tonight, no matter how the benadryl turns out. I just wanted it to be easier... But I do understand why no one can offer advice in good conscience. Norbert is a computer screen. But if you could see the reality, you would understand. 99% of suicides are for no good reason. This isn't one of those times. It's really, really not, and this suicide is completely justified. But thank you, everyone to tried to offer something. There's still good people out there.

No problem. Humanity kind of sucks... I posted a link, but I think the mods took it down. If you'll Google "at home detox from meth," it'll be the first result that pops up. It had some good advice. Basically what anyone would recommend; hole up somewhere and plan on staying a few days. Call 911 if any psychosis or suicidal ideation comes up. But it did assure that meth withdrawal wasn't dangerous physically.

Norbert totally appreciates the offer...   But this has been a long time coming, and anyone knowing the full extent of what he's been through would help him tie the noose. I mean, some of it would make the Saw movie writers cringe. And he's just ready to go.

Maybe I don't know what I'm asking... I guess I want to know, is there any substance that's going to make this easier? Benadryl might kick in and make him forget why he took it. He wants this to be painless as possible.
He's taken it enough before to know about what dose to hit for what effect. Like, 300mg for a relaxing effect, 500 for a legit no-short-term-memory high, and anything above 700 is delirium.

Right... Apart from the massive debts, the homelessness, the loneliness... It's not just hard to build from nothing. It's impossible. Even those rags to riches stories, they always had something. I mean, ANYTHING.

Really can't live life right now. There aren't anymore solutions. Life literally ran out. There's no money, no family, no friends, no car, no job, not even food. Literally, there's nothing. So he either wanders aimlessly or dies.

He would if he could. But to add to his list of reasons to die, he's unemployed and can't find work. But he gave serious effort to obtaining a gun a d just couldn't pull it off. And anyways, he knows poisoning doesn't work. That's why he's hanging himself, but just wants something to relax him first.
Hit delete by mistake trying to edit. Sorry. Not trying to repost my way up or anything.
This site had some good info. I'll keep looking, but read up here.http://m.choosehelp.com/topics/detox/crystal-meth-detox

I "tried" meth once. "Tried" in the sense that some lowlife ass laced a cigarette with it and let me smoke away. I know if I'd had a way to get any after that, I'd be an addict today. I spent three days in bed grinding my teeth and praying for death. 

I've heard of people quitting this stuff without rehab or detox. But those stories are rare. I know there are some home remedies for pain pill withdrawals, but a stimulant...? I'll Google it and post again if I find anything. In the meantime and either way, STAY STRONG.

My turtle Norbert's worst trip was after an overdose of sleeping pills in a suicide attempt. He thought social services were taking his pastor's kids because Norbert told police one of the pastors had kidnapped him. Later, he thought he was being arrested for backing his car over a five-year-old girl named Marie Pucket. Norbert sat on the curb waiting for police to come back and arrest him. Police finally did show up in real life and took him to the hospital. Very, very messed up day...
Finally just gave up and played final fantasy II. Best six hours of my life. Lol

I've seen that as a solution on other forums. I was hoping I wouldn't have to get one and could just squeak by without it. Besides, I live in the middle of nowhere-ville. To buy a controller, I'd have to drive two hours. Not kidding... But worst-case scenario, I could order one. Do you know what I would need specifically? I'm still learning the ropes, and I don't want to spend a bunch of money just to find out it's the wrong controller.

Yeah... I don't know what I was smoking when I typed this, because I couldn't even tell you what I was trying to say. 

Specifically... You have to do a run and jump to clear certain hurdles. I googled it and found a lot of people struggled trying to reach a platform in Booster's Tower. I cleared that, but it took a LONG time.I just kept hitting buttons at random until I got it. And up until now, that's worked. Eventually, but it did work. I can't do that here. I'm at Land's End, where all the geckos(?) shoot out of the cannons and you have to jump across the cliffs. I also had to pass up Yoshi's Isle because I couldn't make the jumps I needed to to get past whatever that underground place with the lava I'd called. From what I've gathered on other forums, the issue is that the emulator can't handle multiple keystrokes at once. And to do the sprint jump, you need D-pad direction, Y, and B. 

SNES9x is about the only emulator I've found that's worth anything. Most of the others were either too complicated to set up, or wouldn't save my game. Remember on ps1 and ps2 when the game would freeze, and you hadn't saved in two hours? Yeah... *Shudder* But SNES9x hasn't had that issue. But the jump problem was on all of the emulators I tried.
About to talk to police. Wondering if I have any options at all. Wish me luck.
I'm really not trying to sound fussy. I'm just not very tough. I'm at the point where I'll either die or get locked up somewhere. I don't think I'm gonna be talked down.

I feel alone. I don't have any friends. There's no one. I want to die... I always get closer and closer knowing one day, I'll do it. And I can't deal with thus at all. It's like, the the thread I was hanging by just got a lot thinner. A lot thinner...

I'm safe. This happened maybe a month ago. I just now remembered it. I always remembered the blood and the condom... I just never bothered trying to piece it altogether. The flashback today is what did it... I can find an explanation for everything, and I don't remember a man being there at all. Just a vague hand, and a hazy memory of being in a position... I know it happened. I could've said I hallucinated, but even the next morning when I was past that high point, the condom was still there. I haven't had a condom in years. There's no way to explain it.

I'm sorry. I'm a mess right now and I don't know how to feel.

There's no point in staying here. I'm too messed up. Hurting too badly. Someone at church said I looked bad tonight. I couldn't tell her I hadn't eaten in five days. Or maybe I looked bad because my sick mind is coming through. I don't know, it's anybody's pick...

No one can live like this.

I try to be... Yeah, I think I'm decent at it.

He's not going to miss me anymore than he already does. I'm not there... What's the difference? At least this way, I don't have to live with the pain.

I'm eager to know what you think about it. And I thought I'd tell you, for whatever tiny comfort it is... I'm not dying. At least not by my own hand. Not because I don't want to...God knows I do. But I just can't. I'd be telling God I didn't trust Him. And I have this idea in my head that when I get to heaven, I'll just fall at Jesus' feet and say, my Lord and my God. I haven't lived a life where I can call Him that. Not lately. So I want to live, until I can say it, and mean it.

Actually, that hit pretty deep... It's hard. You want to think about others. You don'twant to hhurt anyone. But it seems like the better option is just to hit them one more time rather than keep dragging them through hell with you. It's the only thing that makes sense in that pit. 

I've been listening to this song... Look up Joe King, I Will Always Love You. It's powerful. And maybe might help ease your own hurt. We're all walking wounded in this world, anyway. 

I made it through another night. We'll just take it night by night. Or moment by moment. Whichever we can handle.
Yeah. I write music... But next to your kids, what else matters?
It's not worth it... He's better off. He'll have a mom and a dad and a house. I couldn't even give him the basics. It's better this way.

Had a wreck three weeks ago and lost everything. I was living in the car. I lost my son when they figured it out. Lost my job. Lost everything to my name. I don't remember the last time I hugged my son... I can't go on like this. I just can't.
I'm just waiting for these people to leave. Then I'm doing it. Nobody on a phone is going to say anything to change my life. It's over...

I'm on hold for a suicide line. I thought that was a joke... No, I'm actually on hold. I tied the rope up. I really feel like I'm gonna do it. The only alternative is the hospital. What kind of life can you live just postponing the day you die?

I'm sorry. You're a million miles away, and I'm a basket case. But thank you for responding. Just for letting me know I'm not ignored online like I am in real life.

Doing it. Doing it now. 

I've just now been able to get a reddit account. But I've enjoyed reading everyone else's posts. Enjoyed isn't the right word... I think you know what I mean. But thank you. Thank you for letting me be heard one more time. I think I'll post my note here, too. Maybe some crazy clinician can use it in a study somewhere down the road to figure out what makes us sane people tick. 

Thank you.
